hero.title: From the first price to the money in the bank.
hero.lede: Quotations, orders, waybills, invoices and receipts, each usable on its own. Stock and the books follow every step without anyone typing it twice.

jobs.title: Quotes customers can answer
jobs.body: Send a quotation as a link. The customer can accept it or propose other prices, and every offer is kept.

jobs.title: Paid before you supply
jobs.body: Ask for the whole amount or a deposit with a proforma invoice. It is held as the customer's credit until the final invoice.

jobs.title: Delivered, and proved
jobs.body: Waybills take stock out when they leave, are followed on the road and are signed for at the door.

items.text: Quotations, sales orders, invoices and receipts, each usable on its own. Converting one into the next only fills it in for you.
Proforma invoices that ask for all or part of the amount before you supply. They are never posted.
Credit notes with goods back to stock, refunds and writing off a bad debt.
Service lines on any document, next to goods.
Prices taken from your price book: base, wholesale and quantity breaks.
Discount policies with limits for each person and thresholds that go to an approver.
A discount on the whole document, shared across its lines.
Sell in any unit: by the case, by the pack or one at a time, with stock counted correctly.
Waybills that are approved, dispatched with stock, followed, delivered, signed for or disputed.
Stock held for an order the moment it is confirmed.
Approval policies for each kind of document, and numbering for each kind and each place.
PDFs from your own document designs, and till slips for receipt printers.
Each person sells only from the places they are allowed to.
Void an invoice even after it has been part paid.
Search every sales list by customer.

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Orders and waybills move stock in the place they come from.
Invoices, receipts and credit notes post to the ledger by themselves.
VAT and withholding are worked out on every line.
Customers pay a shared invoice online, and the receipt follows.
Every document shows on the customer's page.

faq.q: Can a customer answer a quotation without an account?
faq.a: Yes. You share the quotation as a link; they can accept it or propose other prices from that page, and every offer is kept.

faq.q: Can I take a deposit before I supply?
faq.a: Yes. A proforma invoice asks for the whole amount or a deposit. The money is held as the customer's credit and applied to the final invoice.

faq.q: Can I sell by the carton and count stock one by one?
faq.a: Yes. Each line has its own unit, so stock moves by the right number of items.
